translation.name: One-Handed Sword
profile: A one-handed sword is a substantial, strength-based weapon found in Elaria among trained warriors, guards, and adventurers. It may be a standard product of a good forge or a possession with a long family history. A mark on the hilt and the style of its workmanship can offer clues to its origins without turning an ordinary weapon into a magical artifact.

It allows a hero to combine attacks with a suitable shield, provided the character meets the requirements of both items. It is a straightforward choice for a hero with sufficient strength, although its higher price may leave less money for other supplies. It is not automatically better for every character than an agility-based alternative. Consider the whole equipment set, the group's cooperation, and the hero's actual attributes.

Attacks use Strength (STR). The 1H designation means it uses one hand. The minimum is STR6, and its catalog physical attack bonus (PATK) is +3. The price is 3 gp. A hero's total attack is then calculated from attributes and the applicable rules; the listed weapon bonus is not the entire final attack.
